use_case_summary: Primary: document search + reranking for product analytics help center and in-app answers. Secondary: internal support-agent and long-form summarization for executive briefs. Need consistent p95 latency for reranking during product demos; embedding index size ~25M vectors; cold-starts limited by prefix cache behavior.
capacity_sizing: Hosted trial observed: avg QPS 9.4, peak QPS 38, avg tokens per call ~820 (wide distribution). Workload breakdown: short rerank queries 55% (avg 90 tokens), medium summarization 30% (avg 420 tokens), long context search 15% (avg 1,800 tokens). Forecast (customer ask): sustained baseline 120 QPS, 95th-percentile concurrency ~48, burst capacity to 350 QPS for 5-10 minutes (weekly). Recommended Dedicated candidate sizes: Small: 50 QPS baseline (for staging), Medium: 120 QPS baseline (expected), Large: 300 QPS baseline (for peak/demo days). Suggested infra controls: KV/prefix caching for repeated doc contexts, batching window 15-30ms for reranking to reduce token cost, route long-context requests to quantized model variant. Acceptance test for POC: synthetic replay at 120 QPS sustained for 2 hours with p95 latency <300ms and no OOMs; cost reporting via console token-level breakdown.
pricing_discussion: Initial offer: pilot Dedicated (30 days) with 30% off list dedicated rates, then option to convert to 12-month reserved at 20% discount. Customer requested line items for base reserved GPUs, burst capacity credits, and support SLA uplift. Procurement pushed back on auto-scaling cost transparency; asked for monthly cost cap option. AE to provide 3-tier quote (50/120/300 QPS) plus per-1000-token units for hosted overflow. Estimated ARR if convert: $180k-$260k depending on tier.
